title: Substitution Plan
description: substitution-plan/v1 — the positions to move into the container and the posted positions to recall. Created when the collateral already posted no longer covers the obligation because its assets' rate has fallen: the shortfall is closed by REPLACING positions rather than topping them up, so one event names both sides of the swap. An instruction, not a proposal — where the creating organization has auto-transfer enabled the facade executes it on creation, posting the incoming positions first and recalling the outgoing ones second, as one compensated plan, so the receiver is never under-collateralized in between. The outflow is still gated by the container's own policy, which requires both parties' authorization: the counterparty's consent sits at the ledger rather than in an agreement negotiation.

planId.description: Identity of this plan, so a later event can cite it.

reportId.description: The report whose obligation this plan would settle.

proposedBy.description: The organization proposing it. Events carry roles rather than organizations, so the document pins the organization.

in.description: Positions to post into the container. Executed FIRST, so the container is never short while a swap is in flight.

out.description: Posted positions to recall from the container, executed after the incoming ones have landed. Empty on a plain top-up; a substitution names at least one.
